workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT documentation command IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has explicit Open Documentation activation metadata, but no public requirements import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, bundled documentation contract, documentation command handler, or public documentation payload contract.

splitDecision.reason: Bundled documentation command behavior is a user-information surface with separate requirements and redaction concerns. It should not be coupled to runtime settings or compare execution.

allowed: requirement IDs VHS-REQ-368, VHS-REQ-369, VHS-REQ-489, and VHS-REQ-594
package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
curated bundled documentation concept for extension-user pages
public-safe documentation payload excludes private authority preambles, private links, standards-only requirements content, and private evidence
documentation command can open a local bundled documentation surface without repository access
Marketplace remains disabled until later ADR
runtime settings CLI materialization, compare execution, Docker/LabVIEWCLI execution, packaging, publishing, and source copying remain blocked until separately admitted
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
private GitLab navigation or private authority links in public bundled docs
standards-only control-plane pages in installed-user bundled docs
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateTasks: add tests proving the Open Documentation command is registered as a separate handler from the primary VI History command
add tests proving a curated bundled documentation manifest/page contract exists and is public-safe
implement the minimum documentation command shell that opens or reports the local bundled documentation surface without Git, LabVIEWCLI, Docker, packaging, or Marketplace behavior
blockedTasks: source copying from GitLab or GitHub Suite

allowedNextWork: create the public MIT import packet for installed-user-documentation-command-v1
create the public Spec Kit feature spec, plan, and tasks
add public admission records with implementationStartAllowed false until preflight passes
run public redaction and artifact validation
notAllowedNextWork: implementing documentation command behavior before public preflight
copying documentation implementation source from another VI History authority
adding VSIX packaging or Marketplace publishing
